items.definition:
continuous; without interruption
She enjoyed an hour of uninterrupted sleep.

feeling or showing gratitude or pleasure
She was very appreciative of his help.

arousing pleasure and sadness simultaneously
Saying goodbye was a bittersweet moment.

relating to or involving consent
The agreement was entirely consensual.

relating to the organization and management of a complex operation
The team faced many logistical challenges in organizing the event.

of, relating to, or having a melody; tuneful
The singer had a beautiful, melodic voice.

Active at night
Bats are nocturnal animals.

relating to the Paleolithic diet
She's interested in the paleo diet.

Relating to the Paralympics
He dreams of competing in the Paralympic Games.

Deserving pity
The abandoned puppy looked pitiful.

Happening repeatedly
She suffers from recurrent nightmares.

dark, mysterious
A shadowy figure emerged from the alley.

tube-shaped
The plant had long, tubular leaves.

lacking education
He was uneducated but very wise.

not marked, unidentified
An unmarked police car pulled up.

not yet released
The band played an unreleased song.

(of a product) that has sold in very large numbers.
Her latest novel is a best-selling book.

serving to commemorate
They issued a commemorative stamp for the anniversary.

trite, sentimental, or old-fashioned
His jokes were a bit corny, but they made us laugh.

showing care and conscientiousness in one's work or duties
She is a diligent student who always completes her assignments.

filled with excessive and single-minded zeal
He was a fanatic supporter of the local football team.

glamorous, attractive
She looked very glam in her new dress.

not consisting of or derived from living matter
Water is an inorganic compound.

without life; dull or uninteresting
The room felt cold and lifeless without any decorations.

relating to ancient Scandinavia
Many English words have Old Norse origins.

across land
They traveled overland from Europe to Asia.

concerning the relationship between things
The database uses a relational model.

relating to rotation
The machine has a high rotational speed.

tempting and attractive
The perfume had a seductive scent.

fairly large
They made a sizable donation to the charity.

having no basis in fact
Her accusations were completely unfounded.

not covered by insurance
Many people are uninsured and cannot afford healthcare.

having no title
The artist displayed an untitled work.

having high moral standards
She was known for her virtuous character.

causing irritation; harsh
His abrasive personality made it difficult to work with him.

feeling or showing envy
She was envious of her friend's new car.

relating to family
There's a strong familial resemblance between them.

feeling excited and silly
She felt giddy with excitement.

relating to menstruation
She tracks her menstrual cycle.

without intelligence or purpose
He spent hours on mindless tasks to pass the time.

open to discussion or modification
The price is negotiable, so feel free to make an offer.

relating to or consisting of pictures
The book provided a pictorial history of the city.

not thorough or detailed; suspicious
The information he gave us was a bit sketchy.

relating to Tasmania
The Tasmanian devil is an endangered species.

not broken; continuous
The unbroken silence was unnerving.

very large or impressive
He won a whopping sum of money in the lottery.

able to be brought about or reached successfully
Setting realistic goals makes them more achievable.

relating to the structure of the body
The doctor pointed out the anatomical features on the diagram.

cunning, clever (in a tricky way)
The crafty fox managed to steal the chickens without being seen.

showing open resistance; disobedient
The defiant child refused to go to bed when told.

of, at, or near the equator
The Amazon rainforest is located in an equatorial region.

lacking physical strength, especially as a result of age or illness
The old man was too feeble to walk without assistance.

savagely fierce, cruel, or violent
The tiger let out a ferocious roar that echoed through the jungle.

owing gratitude or money
I am deeply indebted to you for your help.

not conforming to accepted standards of morality or modesty
The show was criticized for its indecent content.

relating to ions or a classical order of architecture
Ionic bonds are strong chemical bonds.

crazy; mad (from Spanish)
That idea sounds completely loco to me.

relating to or denoting migration
Many birds are migratory, flying south for the winter.

with a wide and unobstructed view
The hotel room offered a panoramic view of the city.

giving an advantage or preference to one person or thing over others
They offered preferential treatment to their loyal customers.

noisy and disorderly
The bar was full of rowdy football fans.

lively, bold, and full of spirit; cheeky
She gave a sassy reply to his question.

infected with bacteria; relating to or caused by sepsis
The wound became septic and required immediate treatment.

tending to suggest an idea or feeling
His comments were highly suggestive of a hidden agenda.
